stemMd: Normal fertilisation joins two haploid gametes. What does it restore in the zygote?

options.label: D
options.textMd: The complete removal of genetic variation

options.label: E
options.textMd: Four copies of every chromosome necessarily

explanationMd: Each gamete contributes one chromosome of each type. Their union restores homologous pairs and hence the diploid number, while combining maternal and paternal alleles.

distractorRationale.b: The maternal gamete also contributes nuclear chromosomes.
distractorRationale.e: Two haploid complements produce a diploid complement.
distractorRationale.d: Combining gametes creates a new allelic combination.
distractorRationale.c: The paternal gamete also contributes nuclear chromosomes.
